//step Extra details | Extra details | Nodes can carry links and hover text. Short prefixes become links and icons and line breaks can be added to the text.
//step Links | Links | Add a link by writing the text then a vertical bar then the web address. A plain web address works too. Links to other web sites open in a new tab.

//step Notes and hover text | Notes and hover text | A tooltip line adds hover text to a node. To give a link its own hover text put the link on the tooltip line. Notes come from has note or from text in double quotes.

//sub Notes | Notes ; has note ; Text in double quotes |
//step Prefixes | Prefixes | Short names such as aat: followed by a number become links to the Getty vocabularies. The full list is in the config.json file.
